profile.headline: Software Engineer at Crunchyroll
profile.summary:
Software Engineer and Manager experienced with building React/Redux applications alongside Node and Express, passionate about developing and creating innovative tech. Also experienced in Data Science projects utilizing Python, Pandas, Flask, Streamlit and Scikit-Learn.

Check out my passion project at https://cuecard.tech/ and schedule some birthday messages to your favorite people.

Public Talks
‣ DSML Speaker Series - 2023 | A Machine Learning Approach to Political Segregation & COVID Vaccination Rates https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7cZvqZy8ddc&t=1s&ab_channel=Codesmith
‣ JavaScript the Hard Parts Workshop Series - Async & Promises | Exploring Recursion in JavaScript | Classes & Prototypes | Callbacks & Higher Order Functions
‣ Intro to JavaScript Workshop Series - Functions, Objects, & Execution Contexts

Find me on Github at https://github.com/jaredDlewis

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description:
Attended Recurse Center - a self-directed, programming retreat for people who find joy in building and learning.

Participated in a hackathon - H0: Hack the Zero Stack with Vercel v0 and AWS Databases.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Assigned to CoBank on the Money Movement team:
- Authored OPA Rego rules and refactored API endpoints to enforce authentication/authorization while aligning with REST principles, reducing complexity and strengthening system security
- Created and implemented context-aware and response logging middleware with Node.js’s Async Local Storage, enriching logs with request metadata and boosting observability across services
- Led reconciliation of transaction statuses between the internal transactions database and the financial processing system, ensuring accuracy, data integrity, and consistent reporting across platforms
- Developed Node.js TSOA API endpoints and React/MUI UI components for approvals, transaction templates, and transfer activity, streamlining user workflows for internal bank transfers and wires
- Enforced per-transaction and daily transaction limits through UI notifications and corrected date logic, increasing compliance with customer financial policies and controls
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Express.js · PostgreSQL · Material-UI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer:
- Implemented Express authentication middleware within core API to verify sessions in authentication server
- Reconfigured Docker container networks to enable seamless communication across development, staging, and production environments, optimizing inter-container connectivity and deployment workflows
- Restored use of Cypress End-to-End testing suite by reconfiguring Docker compose files and implementing strategic retries to overcome Redux Form race conditions within tests
- Managed technical debt by migrating multiple repositories from Webpack v4 to 5 to promote scalability and compatibility
- Refactored Express middleware to replace the use of a SQL string generator with parameterized queries and a custom ORM tool, mitigating the risk of SQL injection attack with simple, flexible model interfaces
- Utilized CSS and lightweight component logic to resolve UI/UX obstacles, improving page navigation experience for users
- Provided technical mentorship and taught lectures in full-stack development principles and technologies including algorithms, time complexity, React, Node.js, NoSQL databases, testing and authentication practices
- Performed regular, in-depth code reviews to ensure fellow engineers’ continued progress, efficiencies and clarity
- Proctored technical interviews focusing on JavaScript knowledge, technical communication, and analytical problem solving

Data Scientist & Software Engineer:
- Generalized a Streamlit app used for model evaluation and interpretation to handle models and transformers developed in Scikit-Learn pipelines and updated SHAP code to provide interpretation for both tree- and linear-based classification models
- Sourced a multimodal dataset with tabular, text, and image data, and developed baseline classification models in a Scikit-Learn pipeline to be used to train junior Data Scientists on feature extraction techniques including TF-IDF and PCA

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
- Utilized Python to build out analytical methods replicating and understanding established research on public health outcomes related to Covid-19, including sourcing new data to explore new relationships related to the original research
- Deployed Double Lasso Regression using Scikit-Learn and Statsmodels libraries as an unbiased strategy to select the most appropriate controls that would isolate the relationships between outcome variables and features of interest in our data sets
- Coded the plug-in iterative penalty algorithm from scratch using Stata documentation since no Python libraries currently implement this technique. This was used to select the optimal lambda parameter value for our Lasso regressions 
- Applied Frank’s and Oster’s Sensitivity Analysis to test our results for robustness of statistical relationships. Also developed from scratch since no Python libraries exist for these methods

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created a React application using dynamic, reusable components to maintain a consistent code layout, ease scalability of the codebase, and enforce unidirectional data flow per Flux architecture, leading to easier debugging and maintenance
- Implemented React Router for component navigation within a single page application to optimize page-rendering performance, eliminating transition times by minimizing network requests to the Express server for static content
- Managed state with Recoil, gaining the performance benefits of connecting to specific portions of state in a single source of truth while requiring minimal upfront setup due to its easy integration into React’s functional component architecture
- Rendered a Monaco Editor, a responsive and formatted code editor component, to build a convenient interface for JSON inputs provided by the client to be stored as alert rules to compare against for log monitoring in Elasticsearch
- Employed Gmail’s free Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) to notify clients when logging monitoring thresholds have been surpassed by sending emails configured by the client to contain customized messages that access and display log data
- Utilized Express to implement RESTful server architecture with JavaScript while interacting with the client’s Elasticsearch cluster, making use of middleware to implement modularized request handling to access and query data
- Leveraged Toast UI Chart’s intuitive API to display log counts over time in a responsive and interactive line chart, helping clients notice and address potential problems that can reveal themselves as inconsistencies within total log count trends

positions.title: Memarbor | An Easy-Access Flash Card App
positions.description:
- Applied React Router for dynamic routing to improve the user experience with seamless transitions by conditionally rendering components in a way that allows forward and backward navigation with the browser’s arrow buttons
- Made use of Supertest’s high-level abstraction of HTTP requests to develop unit tests, verifying that requests to the server API endpoints resulted in data being properly created, properly retrieved, and properly deleted from a relational database
- Implemented bcrypt’s industry-proven capabilities to ensure information protection by hashing sensitive user data to protect against brute force attacks

positions.title: Fast Flash | A Fast-Paced Arithmetic Environment
positions.description:
- Leveraged the React-Redux state management architecture to implement a forward-thinking developer environment that allows for high scalability and easy maintenance while eliminating inefficient prop-drilling schemas
- Utilized PostgreSQL to store, update and access structured user data securely and with ACID compliance

positions.title: Nomad | Vacation Budget Estimator
positions.description: - Utilized React Hooks to employ quick updates and efficient memory use with the virtual DOM while allowing lightweight state management in comparison to Redux and consistent functional component structure compared to smart components

positions.title: Mechanical Reliability Engineer
positions.locationName: St. Charles Parish County, Louisiana, United States

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description: Tutored students in engineering, physics and advanced math courses.
